notes.title: Sigh of the Abyss voiced trailer & Kickstarter campaign
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers! I hope you have been well.

I'm pleased to announce that our next project, Sigh of the Abyss, is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rascaldevworks/sigh-of-the-abyss-voice-acting?ref=1840ak]coming to Kickstarter[/url]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34914700/eda49a14ce05ded1ba966300802ad39c94813560.png[/img]
[h3]What is Sigh of the Abyss?[/h3]
[i]Sigh of the Abyss[/i] is a dark fantasy visual novel with a focus on roleplay, choices and relationship. 

Gifted with powers dark and terrible, you are thrust into a divine mission that will place the fate of a nation, a Mediterranean city-state beautiful yet brutal, in your hands.

Take a look at the trailer below!
[previewyoutube=SfSedwfq8nk;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Sigh of the Abyss[/i] features a customizable protagonist, an expansive, choice-driven narrative, and optional romances. If you enjoyed Questlist, you might fancy Sylas or Marané ;)

The [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rascaldevworks/sigh-of-the-abyss-voice-acting?ref=1840ak]pre-launch page[/url] is already up. Get notified of its launch and be one of the first to snag the early bird deals or the limited design rewards!

And if you'd like to have a taste of the world and characters before committing, you can! [i]Shadow Bonds[/i], the standalone prologue, is available for free on Steam.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1829640/Sigh_of_the_Abyss_Shadow_Bonds__Prologue/

Do you have any questions? Whether they're about Sigh of the Abyss, the prologue or the KS campaign, ask away! You can also find me [url=https://twitter.com/RDevworks]on Twitter[/url] or reply to [url=https://us13.campaign-archive.com/home/?u=13faf72fb42f6c6b7c7c50543&id=2f8cc43d40]newsletter issues[/url].

notes.title: Hotfix 8
Celebrate Questlist's one-year anniversary with DLCs + update!
notes.content:
[i]Questlist[/i] released on Feb. 18 2021, one year and some days ago. 
Time flies, and we at [i]Rascal Devworks[/i] decided to properly celebrate this milestone ːsweetelfː
[h1]New DLCs ▪ artbook and dakimakura files![/h1]
Two new DLCs have been added to the game, and launch with a week-long 10% discount!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1913350/After_I_met_that_catgirl_my_questlist_got_too_long__Artbook
Previously available only to Kickstarter backers, the [b]artbook[/b] includes all the artwork of the [u]base game[/u], plus some bonus guides with tips and tricks! It's chock-full with spoilers, so we recommend completing the game at least once before giving it a look.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1913351/After_I_met_that_catgirl_my_questlist_got_too_long__Dakimakura_pack
The [b]dakimakura pack[/b] includes pin-up files of Vera, Téa and Reniel for self-printing! 
They are intended for 150x50cm cases ːcharmwitchː

[h3]Backer DLC pack[/h3]
Kickstarter backers who previously owned the artbook will see it upgraded to the deluxe [b]Backer DLC pack[/b]! The pack includes content of both existing DLC (artbook and dakis), plus exclusive wallpapers and emojis! 

[h1]Anniversary patch[/h1]
Download the latest update to enjoy some bonus content and several fixes!
[h2]New content ▪ meet the Envoy[/h2]
On day 14, after coming back from a chocolate-y mission in Brightway, you'll receive an informal request from Sparkles. Head over to Cyana and you'll be able to meet the Envoy!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34914700/3c4d3bb4740ee7ec3af58fd1935ef35e7e487687.gif[/img]
Are you past day 14? No problem! You're still able to meet her. 
Here's Sparkles' hint: [spoiler]she's been sighted around one of the watchtowers by the sea.[/spoiler]

Complete the encounter to receive a [b]special jewel[/b]. There are three versions of it, and you can only own one. You also won't be able to meet the Envoy on subsequent playthroughs, so choose carefully!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34914700/172bff2af92765c30585afe62ee0764b518c9642.png[/img]
The more battles you win, the stronger the jewel will become. Its power carries over to subsequent playthroughs as well!

If you already completed the game at least once, your meeting with her will be slightly different.

Wait a minute... the Envoy looks familiar, doesn't she? ːfoxintroubleː
You'll be able to play as her in our upcoming game, [i]Sigh of the Abyss - Shadow Bonds[/i] (the free prologue of [i]Sigh of the Abyss[/i])!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1829640/Sigh_of_the_Abyss_Shadow_Bonds
[h2]Improvements / bug fixes[/h2]
This update includes the following bug fixes:
▪ The conversation with Mannie on day 14 has been reworded to be clearer;
▪ The trigger condition for small straights in Dice Delight has been adjusted;
▪ Added a new description in the quest journal for coming second place in the Quizmaster's fist quiz;
▪ Two entries of Téa's diary do not display an incorrect speaker name anymore;
▪ Fixed collision issues in the highway between Cyana and the Breeding Grounds, and the highway between the Breeding Grounds and the Royal Mines;
▪ Fixed an incorrect teleport in Celia's main route;
▪ Fixed gab dialogue in the sewers triggering regardless of party composition;
▪ Fixed getting the achievement for a completed gallery with 34 CGs instead of 35;

[h1]Thank you for a great year[/h1]
The game has been resting at [i]Very Positive[/i] for quite some time! The warm reception has made us incredibly proud, and we're happy so many people experienced the adventures of Vera & co.!
ːangryangrylyraː ːsunnythemenaceː ːpoutycatgirlː ːfoxintroubleː ːcharmwitchː ːsweetelfː
We always wanted to make a [i]good[/i] game and a [i]good[/i] RPG, and we get the feeling we succeeded. 

[b]THANK YOU[/b] for lovely first year! We hope you'll enjoy our future games as well!

[h1]What is [i]Sigh of the Abyss[/i]?[/h1]
[i]Sigh of the Abyss[/i] is a dark fantasy visual novel that puts the fate of a nation in your bloodstained hands.

[h1]What is [i]Shadow Bonds[/i]?[/h1]
[i]Sigh of the Abyss[/i] is a behemoth of a game, and it's still in development.
While [i]Shadow Bonds[/i] serves as a demo, it's a complete experience that will introduce you to the characters and setting of the main game while keeping the plot a mystery. It's also free!

notes.title: Meet the girls!
notes.content:
Are you interested in [i]Catgirl's Questlist[/i] but don't know where to start or who is who? 
We got you covered. Check out these spoiler-free character profiles and meet the main cast!

[h3]The protagonist[/h3]
You'll play as Vera, a charm witch who'll work tirelessly to establish her guild... and find love~
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34914700/b80c03dd7fbc265a3dde11d27b0a3786687be2fd.png[/img]

[h3]The route girls[/h3]
Every guild needs a guildmaster, and the catgirl Téa is more than happy to be the one in charge. She claims to come from another world; she needs to find a way to go back and can't make friends here, or enter a relationship... or so she believes. Will Vera manage to change her mind?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34914700/de4f8144c125ae1df9459721711aef77d1e55c1e.png[/img]

Reniel can't harness magic very well, but that isn't going to stop her! She's ready to charge forward with nothing but a smile. What happens when Vera decides to stand behind her?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34914700/5271c479bbf5c4b7a4080ac5c6747a5a71da1b9f.png[/img]

Sunny seems to know a lot of things that shouldn't really be public knowledge... but the guild wouldn't be the same without her. Will Vera learn the secrets of Sunny's past?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34914700/39fd42455ed06981bd2fb8304a981162af6f2436.png[/img]

Lyra is an accomplished adventurer. Rumor has it that she's in a top guild! Her words are cryptic, but her smile softens when she speaks to Vera... will our charm witch crack the mystery of her heart?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34914700/fc852bc4db4491e845e69d9a33a5e2fcd146e3fe.png[/img]

Celia's motto is to live to have fun, but there's more to her than meets the eye... she's more than happy to comfort Vera after a long day of adventuring~
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34914700/398739b732754c674f354791042048651c341499.png[/img]

[h2]About the release date[/h2]
Here's our current development roadmap; we're happy to announce that we're more or less on schedule!

[list]
[*] Once the script is ready, [i]August [/i]will be spent recording the lines to voice, doing audio editing work and implementation.
[*] [i]September [/i]and [i]October [/i]will be busy months: implementation, bug squashing, balancing...
[*] We will announce a release date once we are confident we can deliver.
[/list]

[h2]Follow us on Twitter![/h2]
Interested in CG sneak peeks, gameplay .gifs and the occasional giveaway? Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/RDevworks][b]Twitter[/b][/url], and don't forget to tell us which girl stole your heart!
